blocks.text: Why marketing operations managers choose Notion

Marketing operations is about keeping the machinery running. You manage data hygiene, system integrations, and team processes. Notion is a flexible tool for this because it lets you build custom databases for your specific needs. You can store your campaign briefs, asset libraries, and process docs in one place.

On a Mac, Notion runs well as a desktop app. You can use the app to keep your workspace separate from your browser tabs. This helps with focus when you are debugging a complex workflow or cleaning up your CRM data. Use the Notion menu bar to check for updates often.
Using Notion for marketing operations workflow

Start by creating a central hub page. Use this for your team wiki. Add a database for your campaign calendar. Use a board view to see your progress at a glance. You can create a template for your campaign briefs to ensure consistency.

items: Create a database for all your marketing assets.
Use a gallery view for visual content like social media graphics.
Add a table view for tracking status and owners of each task.
Use the / command to quickly add new blocks to your pages.

blocks.text: Speed up your documentation with Lazur

Marketing ops managers often face a high volume of documentation tasks. Lazur helps you get these done without switching contexts. Hold the fn key to dictate your process notes. Lazur types them out at your cursor. This is faster than typing long explanations of your workflows.
If you are lost in a large Notion workspace, ask Lazur where a file is. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask. Lazur will point to the location on your screen. This saves you from hunting through nested pages.
Use ⌘ P to open the search bar in Notion. If you cannot find a page, ask Lazur to point to the search bar for you.

You likely import data from your CRM or email tools. Notion allows you to import CSV files. Go to the three dots menu at the top right of your page. Choose Import. Then select CSV. This is a common way to bring in lead lists or campaign performance data.

If your data is complex, use a formula property. You can calculate KPIs directly in your Notion database. This keeps your reports updated without needing to export to a spreadsheet every time. Lazur can explain how to set up these formulas if you get stuck.
Common mistakes in Notion for marketing ops

Many managers make their databases too complex. Start simple. Add properties only as you need them. Another mistake is forgetting to share pages with the right permissions. Always check the Share button at the top right. Make sure your team has the access they need.
Do not let your workspace get cluttered. Archive old projects. Move them to a separate page or a trash folder. This keeps your active workspace clean. It also makes search results more relevant.

faq.question: Does Notion work on my Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, Notion supports macOS 13 or later. Download the app from the official Notion website to get started.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Notion pages?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not edit files or click buttons for you. It helps by dictating text and pointing at elements on your screen.

faq.question: How do I find a specific page in my Notion workspace?
faq.answer: Use ⌘ P to open the search bar. You can also ask Lazur to point to the search bar if you cannot see it.

faq.question: How much does the Notion free plan allow?
faq.answer: Solo users have no block limit. Workspaces with two or more members have a 1,000-block limit.
